newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes higher on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes higher on consolidation.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures recovered slightly with Brent crude on Friday, after a massive selloff the previous day, in what brokers described as technical consolidation.
"Gas oil did very little today. It is acceptable to see today as consolidation, but it could go higher again," a broker said.
November gas oil closed $2.00 higher at $227.00 per tonne, having slumped $13.75 on Thursday. November Brent stood 31 cents up at $23.90 per barrel at 1731 GMT.
